answers.core: This is core. I can conceive of a workaround addon that supports this feature, but it would involve a server that maintains a list of references to every font_size field in the scene tree. There are other workaround addons such as https://github.com/LuisEscorza/GodotLabelFontAutoSizer solving a limited number of use cases (only for Labels and RichTextLabels, and not for any other Control nodes with text fields, like Buttons or TabBar)
answers.workaround: This can be used often. It is used in virtually every modern GUI application, including the one you're reading this message on right now.
